projekte.titel: 614 One – document review by NAHX Technologies
projekte.kurz: Web app in Google Apps Script that pre-reviews document sets for their product and document type and produces a review report and a client report as PDF. Review criteria: <mark class="test">Falk Heinzmann, technical writer</mark>. First pilot customer is FSH Documentation. Pictured: client report from a fictitious test document.
projekte.ausgang: Technical documentation has to meet different standards and legal requirements depending on the product, from machinery to medical devices. Reviews were done by hand, with checklists, and differently by each reviewer.
projekte.herausforderung: A pre-review that applies the right scope for each product and document type, reports every finding with severity, reason and recommendation, and keeps clear what the software checks and what a person has to assess.
projekte.beitrag: I develop most of the software, steered through several AI agents that review each other's work. <mark class="test">Falk Heinzmann</mark> is responsible for the review content; he shapes which requirements the software covers and how understandable the results are.
projekte.ansatz: Review profiles for 42 document types with chapters and references to standards, 14 selectable review areas, text recognition for scans, traffic light with blocking reasons. Every finding is confirmed, rejected or changed by an expert, with a reason; approval only when green and all findings are confirmed. The report does not state conformity.
projekte.technologien: Google Apps Script (V8), Google Drive API with text recognition, Google Sheets as storage with audit log, HTML and JavaScript without a framework, PDF reports; 854 automated tests with Node.js.
projekte.status: Tested locally: 854 automated tests pass, five document types are backed by reference documents. The pilot with FSH Documentation is prepared but not yet approved; evidence from live operation is still pending.
ablauf: Review and client report as PDF

projekte.titel: Jersey Wall – interactive squad page for a floorball club
projekte.kurz: Custom web module: jerseys on a rail, player card with jersey animation and editing via an admin page, no libraries. Pictured: preview with test players.
projekte.ausgang: A floorball club wanted to present its squad on the website: jerseys on a rail, player card with data, maintenance without programming skills.
projekte.herausforderung: An animation after a video reference that runs on phones, data the club maintains itself, and a bilingual interface (German, Ukrainian).
projekte.beitrag: Concept, implementation, data model, admin page, publishing interface, review report with status per finding and handover note for integration.
projekte.ansatz: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript without a build step; all data in one JSON file with validation (required fields, unique IDs); jerseys as generated SVG; animation only via transform and opacity, respecting prefers-reduced-motion; small Python server with token-protected publishing and photo upload.
projekte.technologien: HTML, CSS, JavaScript (no framework), JSON, SVG, Python standard library for the server, Oswald (OFL) for the jersey print.
projekte.status: Module finished and reviewed (review report of 8 Oct 2026 worked through). Integration into the existing club website prepared; club name only after approval.

projekte.titel: Website relaunch and weekly SEO audit
projekte.kurz: Static website from JSON content plus an automated audit routine with PDF reports.
projekte.ausgang: A technical documentation service provider had an outdated site built with a site builder, without clean metadata, sitemap or any way to verify it.
projekte.herausforderung: A website that can be maintained without an agency, is checked automatically on every build and whose visibility is monitored continuously.
projekte.beitrag: Site plan, content as data, build system with checks, legal-text review package for the lawyer, DNS and email checks, audit routine with reports.
projekte.ansatz: Build in Python without packages: content as JSON, output as static HTML with title, description, canonical, Open Graph, JSON-LD, sitemap; checks for headings, links, anchors and alt texts. A weekly audit checks availability, on-page factors, SPF/DMARC and the search index, writes JSON and two PDFs and compares with the previous run.
projekte.technologien: Python (standard library), HTML/CSS, JSON, Chromium via Playwright for rendered pages and PDF reports, GitHub Actions for build and Pages, Markdown.
projekte.status: Website built and verified; go-live is with the operator (domain, legal texts). The audit runs weekly and automatically. Operator name after written approval.

projekte.kurz: The inbox is pre-sorted daily; nothing is moved or answered without my approval.
projekte.ausgang: My own inbox mixes customer mail, receipts, newsletters and advertising. Sorting cost time every morning and was done inconsistently.
projekte.herausforderung: Automation that does nothing on its own: no sending, no deleting, no moving without explicit release, and confidential content stays on the machine.
projekte.beitrag: Design of the workflow rules, scripts, block list, logging, scheduling, tests with stubs.
projekte.ansatz: Apple Mail is only read via AppleScript; a proposal table assigns each mail to a target folder; moving happens only after the exact release word, and the script re-checks sender and subject before every action. Unclear cases always stay put. Knowledge questions are answered by a local model via Ollama, offline.
projekte.technologien: Shell (zsh), AppleScript, launchd for scheduling, Claude Code as interface, Ollama with a local model, Markdown for logs.
projekte.status: In daily personal use since September 2026. Shows what AI support with fixed checkpoints looks like.

projekte.titel: NAHX website: flight through A portals
projekte.kurz: Bilingual website with its own build system, checks, a 3D flight without a framework and a vector logo.
projekte.ausgang: NAHX Technologies needed a presence that works without external services, tracking or form back ends and can be maintained permanently by myself.
projekte.herausforderung: German and English in full, a logo as a true vector from a raster template, fast loading without tracking or external services.
projekte.beitrag: Everything: concept, copy, design system, build system, logo reconstruction, checks.
projekte.ansatz: Content in two JSON files with identical keys, build in Python without packages, checks for language tags, headings, metadata, links and anchors; without a base URL, canonical, hreflang and sitemap are deliberately omitted. Logo measured from the template and rebuilt as SVG paths.
projekte.technologien: Python, HTML/CSS without a framework, SVG, local fonts (OFL), Playwright for rendering and link checks.
projekte.status: You are looking at it, as a preview with test data.

ueber-mich.title: About | NAHX Technologies
ueber-mich.description: About NAHX Technologies: technical services, development projects and digital solutions under one personal brand. Pragmatic, project-based and transparent work.
ueber-mich.einleitung: I work at the intersection of technical documentation and digital development. I care not only about whether something works technically, but also whether it is understandable, practical and suitable for integration into existing workflows.

absaetze: I am Niklas Heinzmann. NAHX Technologies is my personal brand: short paths, direct agreements, and the person who takes the requirements is the one who implements them.

My background is technical documentation: document review and comparison, document control, structure for large document sets, reports and checklists. Development grew out of that, because the tools that make this work verifiable and repeatable were missing.

I work with FSH Documentation, a technical documentation service provider; the website automation, among other things, is created there, and FSH is the first pilot customer of 614 One, the document review tool by NAHX Technologies, whose review criteria are the responsibility of <mark class="test">Falk Heinzmann</mark>. With NAHX Technologies I bring together my own services, development projects and tools under a personal brand.

My approach is pragmatic: understand the requirements, develop a suitable solution and verify the results transparently. I separate facts from assumptions, flag what is uncertain, keep originals unchanged and document changes. That applies to documents as much as to code.
